APPROVE
The extracted helpers keep every condition, its order and its short-circuit behaviour. The value is guaranteed non-null before `IsLookupKeyNotKeyMaterial` runs. Moving out the nested ternary and the long `||` chain should bring the method well under 15. One caveat: I couldn't open the source here, so I couldn't check that `lines` really is `string[]` and `name`/`tail` really are `Match` as the new signatures assume.
